card-carousel.catch.title: Catch a star
card-carousel.catch.description: In this introduction to coding in Pytch, you control a bird using the keyboard, and your job is to catch the star.
card-carousel.boing.title: Boing
card-carousel.boing.description: In the game Pong from 1972, players hit a ball back and forth. Our Boing game, adapted from one in Code the Classics, lets you play against the computer.
card-carousel.qbert.title: Q*bert
card-carousel.qbert.description: Jump around a pyramid of blocks, trying to change the whole stack yellow without falling off! Our version is adapted from one in <srcLink>Wireframe magazine</srcLink>, inspired by the 1982 arcade classic.
card-carousel.splat.title: Splat the moles
card-carousel.splat.description: A game where the player has to splat moles to score points. But if they miss, they lose all their points!
